meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 让它按 Conventional Commits 格式写提交信息，只保留意图、去掉冗余；正文只在破坏性变更、迁移说明等场景才写；结果以可直接粘贴的代码块给出，不执行 git 操作。
howto.when: 当你说「write a commit」、「commit message」、/commit 等，或要求写提交信息时接管；说 stop caveman-commit 或 normal mode 可换回啰嗦风格。

say.note: 给出 Conventional Commits 格式代码块

say.text: 这是破坏性变更，写提交信息时带上 BREAKING CHANGE
say.note: 会补上破坏性变更正文

say.text: 写提交信息，正文说明为什么这么改
say.note: 正文只写非显然的原因

howto.what_en: It makes Claude write Conventional Commits messages compressed to intent only — terse, no fluff, no AI attribution or emoji, extra body only for breaking changes, migrations, etc. It outputs a paste-ready code block and never runs git.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit", "commit message", /commit, or otherwise ask for a commit message. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" reverts to verbose style.

say_en.text: Write this commit message for me
say_en.note: Outputs a Conventional Commits code block

say_en.text: Write a commit message; this is a breaking change
Write the commit message and explain why in the body
